[Yan] Operators gain increased ATK (affected by no. of stacks)
<With 6 different [Yan] Operators on field> At the start of battle, 'Yan's Protection' is summoned with ATK and HP equal to 30% of the total ATK and HP of all [Yan] Operators on the field; can attack 3 targets simultaneously; can use 'Cleansing Flame'; attacks inflict a percentage of ATK as Burn and inflicts Elemental Fragility on surrounding enemies
<With 9 different [Yan] Operators on field> summons 2 'Yan's Protection' instead, with 1.5x ATK and 90% damage reduction

When any [Sargon] Operator activates a skill, all [Sargon] Operators temporarily gain increased ASPD (up to a limit) for a duration (affected by no. of stacks)
<With 6 different [Sargon] Operators on field> Skill activations will also cause all [Sargon] Operators to temporarily gain increased ATK (up to a limit) for the same duration
 When using Narantuya's Strategy, <With 6 different [Sargon] Operators on field> effect changes

[Victoria] Operators carrying equipment deal more damage (affected by no. of stacks)
<For every 25 stacks> Obtain 1 random Victorian Hammer
<With 6 different [Victoria] Operators on field> All [Victoria] Operators carrying equipment gain increased ATK, with an extra increase if equipment is upgraded

[Kjerag] Operators deal increased damage, and even more to Cold and Frozen enemies (affected by no. of stacks)
<With 6 different [Kjerag] Operators on field> A chill gust blows on the battlefield every 25 seconds, inflicting Cold on enemies for a period of time (affected by no. of stacks)

[Laterano] Operators gain ammo on skill activation (affected by no. of stacks)
<With 6 different [Laterano] Operators on field> All [Laterano] Operators gain increased ATK (up to a limit) when any [Laterano] Operator spends 1 bullet

[Ægir] Operators' HP increases (affected by no. of stacks)
When the battle begins, [Ægir] Operators will devour the Operator on the tile in front of them, dealing 5000 Physical damage to the Operator and gaining their base ATK and Block, while adding [Ægir] stacks equal to the devoured Operator's Tier (among [Ægir] Operators, those positioned further up or to the left are prioritized to start a devour)
<With 5 different [Ægir] Operators on field> The first 3 defeated will immediately revive

[Siracusa] Operators gain increased ASPD on deployment for a period of time (affected by no. of stacks)
<With 6 different [Siracusa] Operators on field> [Siracusa] Operators also gain Invisibility for the same amount of time; and have 3% chance to deal a set amount of True damage  (affected by no. of stacks) and inflict Fear for 3 seconds when Invisible, or for 10 seconds after losing Invisibility

On every Operator deployment, [Kazimierz] Operators gain +20% ATK until the battle ends (limit affected by no. of stacks)
<With 6 different [Kazimierz] Operators on field> [Kazimierz] Operators blocking enemies deal 120% of ATK as True Damage and inflict 0.1 seconds of Stun on nearby enemies every 2 seconds; otherwise dealing damage also deals extra 30% ATK as True damage when not blocking an enemy

[Precision] Operators gain increased ATK (affected by no. of stacks)
<With 3 different [Precision] Operators on field> Buff affects all [Precision] and Ranged Operators, and attacks ignore some DEF and RES

[Swift] Operators have a chance when their skill ends to immediately recover 12 SP (affected by no. of stacks)
<At 40 stacks> All Operators have the same chance to recover 15 SP when their skill ends

[Agile] Operators and Operators in the 4 adjacent tiles around them gain increased ASPD (affected by no. of stacks)
<At 40 stacks> Effect range increased to 8 tiles surrounding [Agile] Operators

When [Arcane] Operators deal Arts damage to enemies, the target takes increased Arts damage (affected by no. of stacks) for 3 seconds
<With 3 different Arcane Operators on field> Arcane Operators deal more damage to enemies with less than 50% HP (affected by no. of stacks)

All Operators gain increased HP (affected by no. of stacks)
<With 3 different [Durable] Operators on field> Whenever a non-[Durable] Operator takes damage, 40% of that damage is split among all [Durable] Operators on field. [Durable] Operators taking damage inflict Arts Damage (affected by no. of stacks, triggers up to once every 0.2 seconds) and 40% Fragile for 5 seconds onto their attacker

All Operators gain increased DEF (affected by no. of stacks) and reduced Redeployment Time
When Rest Phase ends, +2 stacks to all active Alliances
<With 3 different [Aid] Operators on field> +4 stacks instead

<For every 10 stacks> Gain +2 Funds
<At 80 stacks (first-time only)> Foresight Operators cost -1 Funds permanently
<At 150 stacks (first-time only)> Above effect changes to: All Dispatch Center Operators cost -1 Funds permanently ([Foresight] Operators on Bench can also count toward activating this Alliance)

On Dispatch Center refresh, there is a chance the next refresh will be free (affected by no. of stacks)
<Every 100 stacks> Gain 20 Funds ([Marvel] Operators on Bench can also count toward activating this Alliance)

Operators' 'When obtained' Attributes trigger twice
<At 100 stacks> 'When obtained' Attributes trigger 3 times instead ([Investor] Operators on Bench can also count toward activating this Alliance)

If a [Raid] Operator's skill is ready or does not attack for 10 seconds, and has no enemies in their attack range, they will redeploy near a ground enemy, use their skill without losing SP, and gain increased ATK and HP during the skill duration (affected by no. of stacks)
<At 50 stacks> All Operators gain +50 ASPD

When a Ground Operator is defeated, there is a chance they will immediately redeploy (affected by no. of stacks)
<With 3 different [Resilient] Operators on field> When defeated, Ground Operators grant +5 SP to all Operators on the field
When activated, +1 Operator count to all Core Alliances on field, and [Harmony] Operators also gain effects from these activated Alliances
